title: The member card is never opened on screen by any test
what: Only the card's facts are checked as data. No test opens the card, prints it, saves the picture or opens WhatsApp from it. The printed page without the panel's menu, the card on one page, the initials in place of a missing photo and the end of the WhatsApp words are never seen.
expected: A screen test opens a member's card as owner and as desk, prints it, saves the picture and checks the WhatsApp words in full.
fix_line: Add one screen test that opens, prints, saves and shares a member card

title: Taking a photo on a member's page is never tested on screen
what: The camera sheet on a saved member's page is never opened by a test. The live preview, the camera trouble messages in full, the file messages in full, the new photo on the list and card, and the camera light going off are never seen. Only helper results and the server's answers are checked.
expected: A screen test with a fake camera takes, uploads, replaces and removes a member photo and checks each trouble message.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the member photo sheet with a fake camera

title: A new member question that arrives just after another was answered is never tested, and likely makes no sound
what: Questions and messages are counted, not listed, and each waiting one is named only by its place in the count. If one is answered and a new one comes in, the count is the same, so nothing looks new and no sound plays. No test tries this; the only test raises the count.
expected: A new question or message always rings once, even when another was answered in the same minute, and a test proves it.
how_often: whenever one item is answered as another arrives
fix_line: Name waiting questions and messages by their own id, then test the swap

title: Undo import is never tested for a member the gym only edited, a cancelled receipt, or a second undo
what: The undo tests keep members who checked in, paid or got extra days. They never try a member whose name or number the gym only edited, an imported receipt the gym cancelled, or pressing undo a second time. The server also refuses the desk's undo, while the desk journey expects one.
expected: Tests prove an edited member and a cancelled imported receipt are kept, and a second undo removes nothing kept.
how_often: each undo after the gym used the data
fix_line: Add the edited, cancelled-receipt and second-undo cases to the undo tests

title: The not-a-spreadsheet message and the same result from CSV and Excel are never checked
what: A picture is answered as unknown inside the reader, but no test checks what the owner sees. No test imports the same rows as CSV, old Excel and new Excel and compares the members and dues.
expected: A test shows the plain message for a PDF or picture, and the same rows in each file kind give the same members and dues.
how_often: each import of an unusual file
fix_line: Add a wrong-file screen check and one same-rows comparison across file kinds

title: Two progress journeys describe a screen the tests say is gone
what: The journeys expect weekly kg lifted on the progress list and a WhatsApp message to the member. The tests require the list to show no 'kg lifted' and require the trainer's ready words to go in the member's app, never WhatsApp. Either the journeys are out of date or the tests lock in the wrong thing.
expected: The journeys and the tests agree on what the progress list shows and where the ready words go.
fix_line: Update the two journeys to the in-app words and workouts-per-week list, or fix the tests

title: The words for a member who does not share workouts are never checked
what: The server tests prove nothing is listed when a member does not share and that switching off deletes the copy. No test checks the words on the member's page that say sharing is off, or that the old figures leave the screen after a reload.
expected: A screen test opens a non-sharing member and a member who just switched off, and checks the words and that no figures remain.
fix_line: Add a screen check of the not-sharing card

title: The phone More page is never checked for the desk, nor compared with the side menu
what: Only the owner's More page is opened, and only its group headings are checked. No test opens More as the front desk, and no test checks that More and the side menu list the same rows in the same order.
expected: A test opens More and the side menu for owner and desk and finds the same rows in the same order.
fix_line: Add a desk More page check that compares its rows with the side menu

title: The Add member joining date is never checked near midnight in India
what: Tests hand the form a fixed today. No test opens Add member just after midnight India time and checks the joining date is today, not yesterday.
expected: A test with the clock just after midnight in India shows today's date as the joining date.
fix_line: Add a near-midnight India clock test of the Add member form
